_comment: DEMO ONLY - NOT A REAL CATALOG. These eight entries describe the products visible on the single bundled sample face-wash shelf (shelf-image.png). They exist so the 3-stage visual-embedding pipeline can be exercised end-to-end before a real product catalog is indexed. Any accuracy number produced against this file is meaningless: the catalog was written by looking at the answer. Replace with a real catalog exported from the product master before reporting any results.

_schema.sku_id: Stable product identifier, surfaced as matched_sku_id.
_schema.brand: REQUIRED. Brand name as it should be scored against ground truth.
_schema.prompt: REQUIRED. Text description embedded into the 1408-D space as the reference vector.
_schema.is_hul: Whether the brand belongs to the Hindustan Unilever portfolio.
